Diagnostic mammogram and ultrasound confirm a 2.3 cm suspicious mass, categorized as BI-RADS 5. Core needle biopsy reveals invasive ductal carcinoma, ER/PR positive, HER2 negative, Ki-67 20%. Clinical staging shows no palpable axillary lymph nodes (cT2N0). She undergoes breast-conserving surgery with sentinel lymph node biopsy and oncoplastic reconstruction. Pathology reveals a 2.4 cm grade 2 invasive ductal carcinoma with clear margins and 2 positive sentinel lymph nodes out of 4 removed (pN1a). No extracapsular extension is noted. The patient has good performance status, no significant comorbidities, and expresses a strong preference to preserve her breast. Oncotype DX testing shows an intermediate score of 24.
